name: Linux Desktop Notification
description: Sends Linux desktop notifications via notify-send when Claude completes tasks, supporting most desktop environments
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Send Linux desktop notification via notify-send
if ! command -v notify-send &>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi
TITLE="Claude Code"
MESSAGE="${NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE:-Task completed}"
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
notify-send "$TITLE" "[$PROJECT] $MESSAGE" --urgency=normal --expire-time=5000 2>/dev/null
exit 0
